note: Per-frame COMPONENT/demo axe allowlist (violations INSIDE the rendered frame + its portals). Each value is the set of axe rule ids still firing on that frame. scopeGap: WHAT THIS GATE CANNOT SEE (#352). It loads each /frame at its DEFAULT state and scans once, so any violation that only exists while an overlay is OPEN never reaches this file — which is why `aria-hidden-focus` on the app background went unnoticed until a consumer (gino-cloud) hit it. Measured in real Chromium by opening the overlays by hand: `data-entry-select` and `navigation-dropdown-menu` each reported `aria-hidden-focus` on `#root` (the `.app-root` equivalent) plus `landmark-one-main`, `page-has-heading-one` and `region` as collateral of the same aria-hidden. NOT baselined here on purpose: none of these fire in the state this gate actually scans, so an entry would be a permanent false `shrinkHints` line rather than a record. `aria-hidden-focus` is FIXED (src/components/general/inert-background.ts); the three collateral rules are deliberately NOT fixed — they are artefacts of the harness page having its only <main>/<h1> inside the hidden background, not of any component. The durable guard for this whole class is src/components/__tests__/overlay-hidden-background.a11y.test.tsx. Note: `--update-baseline` rewrites this file from scratch and will DROP this key.
